- [USER] User expressed interest in the Currywurst Museum and requested more information.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Currywurst Museum is located in Mitte, Berlin, and opened in 2009.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum features interactive displays about the history and culture of currywurst, its preparation, and consumption.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is a tasting area for visitors to try different types of currywurst.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Exhibitions are available in German and English, with audio guides in several languages.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum is a fun and unique way to learn about Berlin's food culture.
